summary: Frontend-only test of new admin button 'Gérer les codes d'accès (Admin)' on /wedding/[clientId]. Login admin → /wedding/hanifa-et-dali → both admin buttons visible (Galerie photo regression OK, new Invite/Codes button OK) → tap navigates to /admin/codes?clientId=hanifa-et-dali → 'Nouveau code' modal auto-opens with Hanifa et Dali pre-selected (highlighted in gold). Direct /admin/codes visit works normally (no auto-open). All acceptance criteria met.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated package detected in console warnings: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the expo-audio and expo-video packages.' Pre-existing across the app, not introduced by this fix.

action_items: (Pre-existing, low priority) Migrate from expo-av to expo-audio / expo-video to silence deprecation warning before SDK 54.
critical_code_review_comments: Code in /app/frontend/app/wedding/[clientId].tsx (lines 353-379) correctly gates the button on `wedding.is_my_wedding || user?.is_admin` and branches to /admin/codes for admins.
Code in /app/frontend/app/admin/codes.tsx (lines 49-54) correctly reads useLocalSearchParams<{clientId?: string}>, pre-selects the wedding and opens the create modal automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: admin@wedding.fr / Admin13!. Login route is /auth/login (NOT /login). All wedding admin actions on /wedding/[clientId] now visible: testIDs wedding-photos-btn and invite-friends-btn. /admin/codes accepts optional ?clientId=<id> to pre-select wedding + auto-open Nouveau code modal.
verified_flows: GET /wedding/hanifa-et-dali → both admin buttons visible (wedding-photos-btn shows 'Galerie photo (Admin)', invite-friends-btn shows 'Gérer les codes d'accès (Admin)' with subtitle 'Générer / révoquer les codes de ce mariage')
On /admin/codes with param → 'Nouveau code' modal auto-opens, 'Hanifa et Dali' row is selected (gold highlighted) in wedding picker
Direct GET /admin/codes (no param) → page loads normally, modal NOT auto-open, + button (create-code-btn) visible — no regression
